answer: Copper Thread Identity Verification requires each new identity to solve a physical puzzle verified by a central authority. The enforcement rule mandates that any operator attempting to create multiple identities must solve the puzzle for each one individually. The concrete per-identity cost an attacker pays is the time and resources spent solving the physical puzzle, which scales linearly with the number of identities created. The karst landscape beneath the server farm makes the physical puzzle uniquely challenging for every operator.
